correctness.rationale: Direct substitution into the published I-LMM equations gives \(x_k=0\), \(d_k=(0,-s_k)\), and \(t_{k+1}=t_k-\lambda_k s_k\). Positivity of \(e^t\) excludes exact finite termination. A uniform sufficient line-search bound under the contrary hypothesis that \(t_k\) is bounded below forces a fixed positive slack decrease and proves \(t_k\to-\infty\). No finite experiment is used to establish the infinite claim.
